locations.note: The wagon party buys supplies and sets out from Independence, Missouri, on the trail west.
Fort Kearney is in the game only because the setting year was moved to 1848, the year the fort opened.
Chimney Rock stands for its area on the trail, while the nearby Scotts Bluff and Courthouse Rock were left out.
Fort Laramie is a supply stop on the way across the plains.
At The Dalles the party chooses between rafting the Columbia River, dodging rocks, and paying the toll to take the Barlow Road.
The journey's destination is the Willamette Valley in Oregon.
Independence Rock is a landmark on the trail between Fort Laramie and South Pass.
The party crosses the Continental Divide at South Pass.
Fort Bridger is one of the forts where the party can stop to trade and rest.
Soda Springs is a landmark on the way to Fort Hall.
Fort Hall is a fort where the party can stop for supplies before the final stretch.
Fort Boise is one of the forts where the party can stop for supplies on the way to the Blue Mountains.

routes.name: Independence to the Willamette Valley
routes.note: The wagon party travels from Independence, Missouri, past Fort Kearny, Chimney Rock and Fort Laramie to The Dalles and the Willamette Valley.
